optimalSolutions.python:
def solve(strs):
    if not strs: return ''
    strs.sort()
    s1, s2 = strs[0], strs[-1]
    i = 0
    while i < len(s1) and i < len(s2) and s1[i] == s2[i]: i += 1
    return s1[:i]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    strs = input().split()
    print(solve(strs))
